content:
OpenAI is developing a feature that allows users to export stickers generated by ChatGPT directly to WhatsApp. Here are the details.

The feature is still under development.

No matter where you are or how old you are, it's almost impossible—even for just a few hours—to get through a day without sending or receiving WhatsApp stickers.

For those unfamiliar with stickers, stickers in messaging apps are small images that users can send in conversations, similar to emojis or GIFs. Stickers are typically organised into sticker packs, which may contain custom illustrations or meme-style images with text.

WhatsApp itself already has a built-in AI sticker generation feature powered by Meta AI, allowing users to create images through text prompts. Now, according to Android Authority, OpenAI appears to be working on bringing similar sticker generation functionality to ChatGPT.

According to the website, the latest version of the ChatGPT Android app contains code strings related to creating, exporting, and downloading stickers, as follows:

ChatGPT stickers　Add to messaging app　Add to WhatsApp　WhatsApp (minimum 3)　Unable to add sticker to WhatsApp　Download sticker

Android Authority added that the "minimum three" requirement comes from WhatsApp, not OpenAI.

Since the feature was discovered by dissecting an APK file, when—or even whether—it will officially launch remains unknown.
